name: sokola-os
description: SOKOLA OS: a modular-monolith operating system for training organizations
comment: The API is Python and has no package.json, so it is not an npm workspace. Its harness is scripts/check.sh, which is what CI runs. Root scripts are thin wrappers over the real ones; they never become a second source of truth.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:spec && npm run verify:api && npm run typecheck:web && npm run build:web
